== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34644) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Sersen LS Y4O.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 23 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 23 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>9c1df006a337b2bcf79331e95c7f0318c764ca68a635643c3cc6e2a1f1c89ab5</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Luke Skywalker (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_20^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>204_35^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>10_25*, 10_8*, 12_66*, 13_15*, 13_22*, 13_27*, 13_3*, 13_30*, 13_37*, 13_4*, 13_44*, 13_6*, 13_8*, 1_70*, 1_90*, 200_16*, 200_28*, 200_35*, 200_39*, 200_47*, 201_18*, 204_3*, 207_17*, 208_17*, 208_18*, 208_24*, 208_26*, 209_31*, 211_28*, 211_32*, 211_42*, 2_23*, 3_59*, 5_24*, 6_56*, 7_97*, 8_40*, 9_39*, 9_51*, 9_57*, 9_81*</nowiki>.
